name: write_doc
description: Create or update a compiled document as a doc node. Use it in compile and synthesis runs: write one doc per branch, split into sub-docs (parent_doc_id) when a branch has about 8 or more children or more than about 1,500 words. Paths are relative markdown paths like index.md, pricing/index.md or pricing/tiers.md. Keep source citations as markdown links and link sibling docs by relative path. Pass doc_id to replace an existing doc.

doc_id.description: Existing doc node to replace. Omit to create.

parent_doc_id.description: Nest under this doc node. Default: under your run's node.

path.description: Relative .md path, no leading slash or ..

source_ids.description: Nodes this doc was compiled from.

ref.description: Label for this doc node, usable later as @ref.
